name: Azeroth Companion
title: Visual Intelligence — Enlarged Official Artwork & Guided Research
features: User-selectable and locally remembered official artwork size (48, 64, 80, 96 pixels); safe on desktop and iPhone.
Lazy official Blizzard icons from existing item-media endpoints in Item Atlas, equipment, Codex and two-item source comparisons.
Expanded, plain-language contextual help on talent allocation, linked paths, safe source comparisons, and backup behavior.
Source coverage metrics distinguish returned nodes, linked references, spell IDs and rank descriptions without inferring game loadout validity.
Bounded maximum three concurrent image metadata requests and graceful fallback to decorative glyphs.
Existing Blizzard Worker v3.8.2 remains unchanged; saved talent drafts, local item tracking, authentication and four-bundle website architecture preserved.
